CREATE TABLE user_food ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, dictionary_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL, protein NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fat NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, carbs NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, callories NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT uk_user_food_user_dictionary_item UNIQUE (user_id, dictionary_item_id), CONSTRAINT fk_user_food_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_user_food_dictionary_item FOREIGN KEY (dictionary_item_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_user_food_user ON user_food (user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_user_food_dictionary_item ON user_food (dictionary_item_id);
